patch_description: This generator optimizes for the simply-typed lambda-calculus (STLC) by using an Extreme Asymmetric Application Spine (92/8 split) to maximize term size toward the 100-node limit. It implements "Inhabitant-Preference" typing, where argument types for applications are picked from the existing context with 90% probability, ensuring arguments can be satisfied by variables (`VarTm`) rather than literals, which drastically improves variable reuse and keeps the spine growing. It uses dynamic naming `f"v{len(ctx)}"` to guarantee 100% unique sub-terms and employs a hard-floor logic to ensure type validity even when the budget is exhausted.
